notes: Covers the R-820BK and R-820BW. The parts list also includes a convection motor and heaters, so this is a combination oven.

method: Sharp R-820BK/R-820BW service manual (manualslib copy), parts list: power transformer, HV capacitor, HV rectifier, fan and turntable motors, interlock switch, thermal cut-outs and monitor fuse / switch assembly with part numbers.
Rows were matched by position in the extracted page text, so check the printed page before ordering.

comps.spec: Power transformer, part RTRN-A568WRE0 (parts list ref 1-18)
High voltage capacitor, part RC-QZA173WRE0 (parts list ref 1-5). Interchangeable alternate RC-QZA211WRE0 is also listed.
Fan motor, part RMOTEA370WRE0 (parts list ref 1-6).
Turntable motor, part RMOTDA231WRE0 (parts list ref 1-3).
Secondary interlock switch / door sensing switch, part QSW-MA110WRE0 (parts list ref 1-1).
Thermal cut-out 170 deg., part RTHM-A048WRE0 (parts list ref 1-16). A second cut-out, 125 deg., is part RTHM-A078WRE0 (ref 1-17).
High voltage rectifier assembly, part FH-DZA025WRK0 (parts list ref 1-4)
Monitor fuse and monitor switch assembly, part FFS-BA021WRK0 (parts list ref 1-2)

sources.title: Sharp R-820BK service manual, parts list (manualslib, page 43)
